description: BD CARTO® Réseau routier - Tronçon route - Eure is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The CARTO® BD version 3.2 is the reference map database. Used from the departmental scale (1: 50,000e) regionally (1: 250 000), it describes all the information present in the metropolitan territory and the overseas departments. The different themes are: ADMINISTRATIVE; EQUIPMENT; DRESSING; HYDROGRAPHY; NETWORKFREE; NETWORKROUTIER; TOPONYMY. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "BD CARTO® Road Network — Road Pump — Eure" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include géographie, Hydrographie, Réseaux de transport, hydrographie, organisation administrative, administration. The listing shows 2018-01-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
